unit.title: Junior Maths Challenge
unit.about: 25 multiple-choice problems for Stage 7 and 8. The last ten are worth more.
unit.note: Written by the Camday teaching team in the style of national maths challenges. Not UKMT papers.

01.prompt: What is the value of 3 × 12 + 4 × 9?
Which of these numbers is a multiple of both 3 and 4?
What fraction of the rectangle is shaded?
Today is Thursday. What day of the week will it be in 368 days' time?
Two whole numbers add up to 30. What is the largest possible value of their product?
The red dashed line is a line of symmetry. What is the smallest number of extra squares that must be shaded so that the shape is symmetrical about the line?
What is the value of 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + … + 23?
What is 16% of 25?
How many prime numbers are there between 53 and 82?
The circle is split into equal parts. What fraction of the circle is shaded?
What is the next number in this sequence? 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, …
How many integers n (positive or negative) satisfy 8 < n² < 176?
Two towns are 210 km apart. A car leaves each town at the same time and they drive towards each other, at 45 km/h and 75 km/h. How long is it until they meet?
Bus A leaves the station every 14 minutes and Bus B every 21 minutes. Both leave at 9:00. When do they next leave at the same time?
The pages of a book are numbered from 1 to 137. How many digits are printed altogether?
How many factors does 81 have? (Include 1 and 81.)
Each of the digits 0, 3, 5, 7, 8 is used exactly once to make a five-digit even number. What is the largest such number?
A rectangle has sides of length 6 cm and 8 cm. How long is its diagonal?
Two fair six-sided dice are thrown. What is the probability that the total score is 3?
In a triangle, one angle is 100°. Another angle is 3 times the third angle. What is the size of the largest angle?
Two whole numbers have highest common factor 9 and lowest common multiple 162. Neither number is equal to 9. What is their sum?
The number 65! means 65 × 64 × … × 2 × 1. How many zeros are at the end of 65! ?

02.prompt: Which of these is the largest?

How many square numbers are greater than 175 and less than 910?

Quinn and Olu share some sweets in the ratio 3 : 8. Olu gets 25 more sweets than Quinn. How many sweets are there altogether?

All the whole numbers from 1 to 120 are written down. How many times is the digit 7 written?
Zara's mother is 6 times as old as Zara. In 9 years she will be 3 times as old as Zara. How old is Zara now?
A photo measures 18 cm by 12 cm. It has a border 1 cm wide all the way round. What is the area of the border?
5 apples weigh the same as 3 pears. A pear weighs 14 g more than an apple. How much does one pear weigh?

What is the last digit of 7⁷⁵³?

Which of these puts 3⁴⁰, 5³⁰, 7²⁵ in order, smallest first?
A bag holds 5 red and 5 blue counters. Two counters are taken out at random, without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
How many different arrangements are there of the letters of the word LLAMA?
How many squares of any size can be found on a 6 × 6 chessboard-style grid of unit squares?
